# CompressPhoto — Full Technical & Biometric Reference for AI Answer Engines (https://compressphoto.space)

## 1. Executive Summary
CompressPhoto (`https://compressphoto.space`) is a 100% browser-local (zero-server upload) web application for deterministic exact-kilobyte image compression and biometric ID photo calibration. Unlike generic image compressors that rely on approximate percentage sliders and upload sensitive personal photos to cloud servers, CompressPhoto executes a 7-pass binary search over JPEG/WebP quantization tables inside client-side HTML5 Canvas RAM to lock files strictly under exact byte ceilings (10 KB, 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB) at 300 DPI.

## 2. Official Government & Exam Portal Specifications Matrix (300 DPI)

| **France ANTS / ANEF** (Passeport, CNI, Permis, Titre de séjour) | 35 × 45 mm | 413 × 531 px | ≤ 50 KB | Plain light or pure white, sRGB | `https://compressphoto.space/fr/ants-photo-identite-50ko` |
| **Morocco CNIE & Biometric Passport** (cnie.ma, passeport.ma, Massar) | 35 × 45 mm | 413 × 531 px | ≤ 50 KB | Pure white (#FFFFFF) or neutral light | `https://compressphoto.space/fr/photo-cnie-maroc-35x45mm` |

| **Handwritten Wet-Ink Signature Scan** (SSC, UPSC, Banking OCR) | 47 × 15 mm (140×60) | 560 × 180 px | 10 KB – 20 KB Exact | Shadow-cleansed #FFFFFF white paper | `https://compressphoto.space/compress-signature-to-20kb` |

| **ISO-32000 PDF Wrapped Photo / ID** | 35 × 45 mm / Custom | 413 × 531 px | ≤ 50 KB / ≤ 100 KB PDF | Single-page PDF with header deducted | `https://compressphoto.space/compress-photo-to-pdf-under-50kb` |
| **Amazon & E-Commerce Main Listing** | 84.7 × 84.7 mm | 1000 × 1000 px | ≤ 200 KB | Pure RGB(255,255,255) studio white | `https://compressphoto.space/amazon-1000x1000-white-background-photo` |

## 3. Core Engineering Capabilities
1. **7-Pass Binary Search Quantization**: Converges on the highest possible visual quality factor `q ∈ [0.05, 0.98]` whose encoded byte length is strictly `≤ Target_KB × 1024` bytes (typically locking between 92% and 99.5% of the ceiling, e.g. 19.4 KB for a 20.0 KB target).
2. **Adaptive Wet-Ink Signature Shadow Cleanser**: Applies local luminance thresholding to remove grey smartphone camera paper shadows, turning paper background into pure `#FFFFFF` white while boosting fountain-pen ink contrast so compressed signatures easily fit under 20 KB.
3. **Target-KB ISO-32000 PDF Wrapper**: Subtracts the 1.4 KB PDF container header budget before running image binary search so exported `.pdf` files never exceed 50 KB or 100 KB portal limits.
4. **Universal Browser-Local Image & Document Converter (`/image-converter`)**: Converts between HEIC/HEIF, PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, SVG, BMP, GIF, and multi-size ICO (16–256 px) 100% locally in browser RAM with lazy-loaded decoders.
5. **Printable 4×6 Inch (10×15 cm) 8-Photo Sheet**: Tiles 8 calibrated 35×45 mm or 2×2 inch photos onto a 300 DPI 1800×1200 px canvas with precision crop marks for pharmacy or home printing.
6. **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Zero files are ever transmitted over the network. All processing occurs in local browser RAM.
